title: 10D Completion: Anti-Octonion and Dual-B-Complex Scaling
summary: Completes the dimensional model with all 10 dimensions: 0D (origin/Higgs/0^0=i) + 8D (octonion) + 9D (anti-octonion) + 10D (Dual-B-Complex). The key discovery is that 10D → SO(10) GUT → 16 chiral spinor = one fermion generation → 15 SM + 1 sterile ν → 225 = 15² → 240 = 15×16 → E8 → 721 = 3(240)+1.

dimensions.0D: origin = Higgs = 0^0 = i (the seed, the +1 in 721)
dimensions.9D: anti-octonion e8 (scaling transformation, e8²=+1, split signature)
dimensions.10D: Dual-B-Complex e9 (final scaling, e9²=0, nilpotent, SO(10) gauge group)

algebraic_properties.e8_squared: +1 (split signature, unlike octonion imaginary units which square to -1)
algebraic_properties.e8_commutation: e8 commutes with all octonion elements
algebraic_properties.e9_absorption: e9 × e_i = e9 (absorbing, like dual number multiplication)

so10_chain.step_2: SO(10) chiral spinor = 16 = one fermion generation
so10_chain.step_5: 15 × 16 = 240 = E8 root count (E8 contains SO(16) ⊃ SO(10))

key_insight: The framework's 15 and 16 are NOT arbitrary choices. They come from the SO(10) Grand Unified Theory: 16 is the dimension of the SO(10) chiral spinor representation (one full generation of fermions including the sterile neutrino), and 15 is the number of Standard Model fermions (16 minus the sterile neutrino). This means 225=15², 240=15×16, and 721=3(240)+1 all have physical meaning.

fermion_count.note: One generation: u_R, u_L, d_R, d_L (×3 colors) + e_R, e_L, ν_e_L, N_R = 4×3 + 4 = 16

literature_connections.SO10_GUT: The SO(10) Grand Unified Theory is well-established in particle physics. The 16-dimensional chiral spinor contains exactly one generation of SM fermions plus a sterile neutrino.
literature_connections.E8_contains_SO16: E8 contains SO(16) as a maximal subgroup. The 240 E8 roots can be decomposed using the SO(16) structure.
literature_connections.Furey_division_algebra: Furey's work shows the SM gauge group emerges from R⊗C⊗H⊗O. The 10D structure extends this to SO(10).
literature_connections.Manogue_Higgs: The Higgs field appears as the scalar term of a superconnection in the octonion/Clifford algebra framework. The 0D origin = Higgs postulate connects to this.
